A minute's walk from the baroque Mary Magdalene Church, this genteel spa hotel is 5 minutes on foot from the hot springs at Mill Colonnade, and 2 km from Diana Observation Tower.

About this hotel

A minute's walk from the baroque Mary Magdalene Church, this genteel spa hotel is 5 minutes on foot from the hot springs at Mill Colonnade, and 2 km from Diana Observation Tower.

Check-in time: 14:00
Check-out time: 11:00
